source.organization: General Authority for Islamic Affairs, Endowments and Zakat
source.methodology: Counting the number of Quran memorization circles and students during the specified period

indicator.name: Number of Quran memorization circles and their students
indicator.definition: Total number of Quran memorization circles in mosques and the registered students during a specified period

mosque_name.description: Name of the mosque hosting Quran memorization circles (in Arabic)

branch.description: The city/region where the mosque is located (e.g. Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Dubai)

area.description: The specific neighborhood or district within the city (in Arabic)

quran_circles.description: Number of Quran memorization circles (halaqat) held at this mosque

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the mosque (where available; some source values are malformed)

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the mosque (where available)

terms.definition: A place designated for prayer; includes the mosque's courtyards, entrances, annexes, and facilities

terms.term: Number of Quran Memorization Circles in Mosques
terms.original_arabic: عدد حلقات تحفيظ القران في المساجد
terms.definition: Total number of accredited educational circles held in mosques for teaching Quran memorization and recitation during a specified period and within a specific geographic area
terms.calculation: Total number of Quran memorization circles in mosques

terms.definition: Total number of individuals actually enrolled in Quran memorization circles during a specified period and within a specific area
terms.calculation: Total number of students in circles

terms.definition: Digital address of the place on the globe, precisely determining its location using latitude and longitude
terms.calculation: Total number of Quran memorization circles in mosques by location
